title: 第22章 你想要什么
novel_title: 开局废灵根，成了宗门团宠小师叔
content_zh:
大概是来过一次了，这一次顾念念更加的轻车熟路。

    昨日，萧易水给她带了一件嫩黄色的仙罗裙。

    小姑娘今天就穿上了。

    这会儿走在一片嫩绿的树丛中，别提多挑眼。

    忽然，

    顾念念停了下来。

    “你们没听见什么吗？”

    桃夭和小六同时安静了一下来，可仔细听了半天，这两愣是一点动静也没察觉到。

    “主人，你是不是听错了？”

    顾念念又侧着耳朵听了一会儿，确实没什么声音。

    “难道真的是我听错了？”

    萧易水和洛师兄都说过，桃夭是先天灵宝，又生了灵智，是灵器，即便她这个主人现在只有练气境，可桃夭却可以发挥出金丹境的威力，它都没听出来什么，那应该就是没有什么的。

    再说了，即便桃夭没听出来，小六可是灵液灵石，最是能察觉隐匿的气息，它都没察觉到任何异常，那就是她听错了。

    这么一想，顾念念又蹦蹦跳跳地往前走。

    渐渐地，四处的光线开始暗淡下来。

    灵气也开始越发稀薄起来，一股说不清道不明的阴冷感，开始如影随形。

    顾念念再次停下脚步，捏着小拳头，四处查看。

    桃夭和小六分别趴在她的两个肩头上，此时也察觉到了一丝异常。

    桃夭问小六：“上次我们来的时候，这里是这个样子吗？”

    小六脸色发白，它很确定上次来的时候，这里不是这样的，至少没有这几块大石头。

    而且每一块还都是极品灵石。

    像是被人故意放在这里，就是为了引起注意。

    这么大的极品灵石，便是它也眼馋的不行。

    明明很害怕，可看着这些灵石，小六还是忍不住的吞咽口水。

    顾念念抿着嘴，忽然转头看向了右手方向。

    刚刚，她明明感觉到哪里有什么东西在盯着她，可是当她去看，那种感觉又没有了。

    桃夭小声问顾念念：“主人，要过去吗？”

    顾念念拧着小眉头，心里有些犹豫。

    老乞丐可是耳提面命的教过她的。

    天上掉馅饼的好处，那是会要命的。

    “我们绕过去！”

    小六眼里立刻露出了惋惜。

    桃夭也是。

    可两人趴在顾念念的肩头，谁也没动。

    经过那几块极品灵石的时候，小六明显有些意动，被桃夭一下子压住了。

    “主人说不可以！”
content_en:
He had probably been here once before, and this time Gu Niannian was even more familiar with it.

    Yesterday, Xiao Yishui brought her a bright yellow Xianluo skirt.

    The little girl put it on today.

    Walking among the green trees now, don't be too picky.

    suddenly,

    Gu Niannian stopped.

    "Didn't you hear anything?"

    Taoyao and Xiaoliu were quiet for a while at the same time, but after listening carefully for a long time, they didn't notice any movement at all.

    "Master, did you hear wrongly?"

    Gu Niannian listened for a while and found that there was indeed no sound.

    "Did I really hear it wrong?"

    Xiao Yishui and Senior Brother Luo both said that Taoyao is an innate spiritual treasure with spiritual wisdom and a spiritual weapon. Even though her master is only in the Qi training realm, Taoyao can exert the power of the Golden Core realm. If it doesn't hear anything, then it should be nothing.

    Besides, even if Taoyao didn't hear it, Xiaoliu was a spirit stone that could detect hidden auras. If it didn't notice anything unusual, that meant she heard it wrong.

    Thinking of this, Gu Niannian jumped forward again.

    Gradually, the light everywhere began to dim.

    The spiritual energy also began to become thinner and thinner, and an indescribable coldness began to follow him like a shadow.

    Gu Niannian stopped again, clenched her fists, and looked around.

    Taoyao and Xiaoliu were lying on her shoulders respectively, and they also noticed something strange at this time.

    Tao Yao asked Xiao Liu: "Is this what it looked like last time we came here?"

    Xiaoliu's face turned pale. He was very sure that the last time he came here, this place was not like this, at least there were not these big rocks.

    And every piece is a top-quality spiritual stone.

    It seemed like it was placed here deliberately to attract attention.

    Even it is greedy for such a big top-quality spiritual stone.

    Obviously he was very scared, but looking at these spiritual stones, Xiao Liu couldn't help but swallow his saliva.

    Gu Niannian pursed her lips and suddenly turned her head to look to her right.

    Just now, she clearly felt that something was staring at her somewhere, but when she looked, that feeling was gone.

    Taoyao asked Gu Niannian in a low voice: "Master, do you want to go over?"

    Gu Niannian frowned, feeling a little hesitant.

    The old beggar taught her this.

    The advantage of pie in the sky is that it will be fatal.

    "Let's go around!"

    Xiaoliu's eyes immediately showed regret.

    Taoyao too.

    But the two of them were lying on Gu Niannian's shoulders, and neither of them moved.

    When passing those top-quality spiritual stones, Xiao Liu was obviously moved, but Tao Yao suppressed him immediately.

    "The master said no!"
